spec_match.rationale: The copy now distinguishes 'LoAF supported but no entry' from 'no long-task type', and explains that a Chromium worker entry spans the congested moment (first queued ping to end of backlog), not the loop itself.

interactive.rationale: Duration control, "Block the worker" and Clear update witnesses and the ping log.

edge_cases.rationale: No coverage of several short blocks in a row or of a shared/service worker (prototype is dedicated-only).

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Unflagged: 5 PASS / 1 FAIL (the worker entry type); with --enable-blink-features=LongAnimationFrameWorker (status "test"): 6/6 PASS.

runtime_evidence.rationale: With --enable-blink-features=LongAnimationFrameWorker, three consecutive runs on blocking-a-worker each reported their own entry (360/360/361ms; previously run 1 'Nothing observed it'), and hand-rolled-loaf three runs each reported 1 entry; unflagged both report nothing honestly. Root cause: the self-timer's 4ms setTimeout chain never left Chromium's 5ms idle gap, so the congested moment never closed; worker.js now ticks at 16ms, drains observer.takeRecords(), matches entries to the block by time span, and polls up to 1.5s.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.
